comments.comment:
Just for upd.

I've found a number of issues that are fixed in the PR, but the test still fails, however other TC tests looks good.
For now, the issue with unexpected tx state looks resolved, but sometimes latest entry updates can be missed after rebalance.

What was done:

  • entry full history is sent within single message and apply either entire history or nothing under same entry lock.
  • fix version hints usage in "update with history" operation.
  • minor code cleanup.

The main issue is Rebalance iterator can cache rows and doesn't coordinates with Vacuum, so cached rows can easily become stale.
E.g. Vacuum has completed after iterator read rows from page and before cursor requests next row from iterator. In this case cursor can get row without hints, and TxLog has no states for the row versions anymore.

Usually, an mvcc cache iterator is used with snapshot in queries that prevents Vacuum from cleaning up TxLog, but rebalance iterator takes no snapshot.

Seems, we have to actualize row states on read instantly, to make sure all committed rows will be rebalanced. 
Note, vacuum should see real row state as it stored in data page.

--> Run :: All: No blockers found!

TeamCity --> Run :: All Results

amashenkov, patch looks very good for me. You've fixed a lot of stuff. But there are several unclear points for me:

  1. GridCacheMvccEntryInfo - looks like the estimate of the entry size is wrong:
    SIZE_OVERHEAD = 4 * 8 /* long / + 2 / int */;
    Shouldn't it be
    SIZE_OVERHEAD = 4 * 8 /* long / + 2 * 4 /* int */; ?
  2. I've noticed that we set missed hints to opCntr in the three places:
    1. GridDhtPartitionSupplier#extractEntryInfo
    2. MvccDataRow#readHeader
    3. GridDhtTxAbstractEnlistFuture#fetchHistoryInfo
      What if instead of duplicating such a messy and low-level code in several places we would left it only within MvccDataRow#readHeader?
  3. A bit weird naming of the added variable in GridCacheMapEntry.java:6735. Looks like the real meaning of this variable is opposite. Would it be better to remove negation and then do if (!added) break;?
  4. Why do we need additional WAL entry for the latest entry (entries[0]) in the case of delete operation at GridCacheMapEntry.java:6765?
  5. Is it possible to use BPlusTree#find(Max, Min, RowData.LINK_ONLY) and then check for GridCursor#next to find out if there is any history of row exists in the tree, Instead of using CheckHistoryExistsClosure in IgniteCacheOffheapManagerImpl.CacheDataStoreImpl#mvccApplyHistoryIfAbsent?
  6. Why do we need 400 GB region size in mvcc case? See GridCTextacheRebalancingSyncSelfTest.java:111

rkondakov, thanks for pointing.

I've fixed typos, redundant row state actualization.

What about effective row history check: no, without closure Ignite will fetch all rows from page, but we want just check there is smth or not.
I'll fix this using proper method with ClosureCursor instead of ForwardCursor.

TC tests restarted.
